summary_zh: 一个本地浏览器审核界面，可接入 AI 编码代理。用于标注计划、规格、消息和 HTML，审查本地改动或远程 PR/MR，在收件箱集中处理代理的提问，并将反馈一键发回代理。
audience_zh: 适合使用 Claude Code、Codex、Copilot CLI、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码代理的开发者与团队，用于审核文档、计划和代码差异并与代理协作。

evidence.quote: Plannotator is a local, browser-based review surface for AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Kiro, Droid, Amp, DeepSeek Harness, and Pi. Plannotator Inbox also works with personal assistants (Grok Bot, Muse, Hermes, OpenClaw).

**It plugs directly into your agent** through plugins, hooks and commands. When the agent proposes a decision, plan, html, or finishes working, the app opens in your browser and you mark it up, comment, and send feedback directly to the agent for it to act on it.
Review local changes or remote PRs. Comment on diffs, suggest code. Your comments go back to the agent. Works with Git, GitButler, Jujutsu (`jj`), Perforce (`p4`), GitHub, and GitLab.

The Plannotator Inbox is one local window where your agents leave you messages, questions, files, and guided reviews while they keep working.
